title: Queue-row amber-0 count/draw predicate asymmetry — the new pin enshrines count-side semantics draw_noc_panel doesn't honor
evidence:
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:602: `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] > 0 || (amber_pct > 0 && p.util_pct >= u32(amber_pct)) {`
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:772: `if p.q[0] + p.q[1] + p.q[2] == 0 && p.util_pct < u32(amber_pct) {`
app/render/noc_overlay.odin:833: `if cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct <= 0 || p.util_pct < u32(cat.balance.warnings.pipe_red_pct) {`
app/render/noc_overlay_test.odin:321: `testing.expect_value(t, noc_queue_rows(&sr, 0), i32(1))  // amber 0 = only the queued pipe`
core/catalog.odin:952: `b.warnings.node_red_pct > 100 || b.warnings.pipe_amber_pct < 1 ||`
detail: Test pins count-side amber-0 = queued-only, but the draw skip lacks the amber>0 guard the red section carries: at amber 0 measure and draw disagree row-for-row (the documented invariant at line 570). Catalog validation rejects amber<1, so defensive-config only.
recommended_fix: Mirror the red side: make the queue-row draw skip `amber_pct <= 0 || (q==0 && util < amber)` — or drop the count-side guard and the amber-0 pin so both predicates stay identical.

title: spawn_fx tx-ring clone: regression coverage is harness-only — the unit round-trip cannot see ring corruption
evidence:
app/render/spawn_fx.odin:209-210: `c.bundles.tx_slot_tick = clone_dyn(b.tx_slot_tick, allocator)` / `c.bundles.tx_served = clone_dyn(b.tx_served, allocator)`
app/render/spawn_fx_test.odin:126-128: `pp.step(&s, 66, {}, &cat)` / `pp.step(&clone, 66, {}, &cat)` / `testing.expectf(t, sfx_hash(&clone, &cat) == sfx_hash(&s, &cat),`
detail: The round-trip steps the clone with an empty batch (no topology edit → no rebuild/resize fires through an aliased ring) and state_writer never folds tx_slot_tick/tx_served, so the hash compare cannot see ring corruption — deleting spawn_fx.odin:209-210 passes this test; only the 48-demo harness caught the bug.
recommended_fix: Add a unit pin: populate the ring, shadow_clone, apply a topology edit on the clone, then assert the live run's tx_slot_tick/tx_served bytes are untouched.

detail: N5 bumped the marker v1→v2 for the new P-row schema; row literals are pinned but no assertion covers the marker text itself — a silent revert or typo passes all tests (live==replay compares same-code streams; only length and emit-absence are checked).
recommended_fix: Add one strings.contains(out, "# pp stats stream v2") pin to test_stats_csv_literal_rows alongside the existing row literals.
